.decl status_contender(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, state: symbol, reason: symbol)
.decl status_disagreement(tenant: symbol, delivery: symbol, step: symbol, run: symbol, reason: symbol)

status_observation_state(event, "success") :- loop_status_observation__relation(event, "done").
status_observation_state(event, "failure") :- loop_status_observation__relation(event, "stuck").
status_observation_state(event, "pending") :- loop_status_observation__relation(event, "planned").
status_observation_state(event, "pending") :- loop_status_observation__relation(event, "waiting").
status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, event, at, state, reason) :-
loop_status_observation__tenant(event, tenant), loop_status_observation__delivery(event, delivery),
loop_status_observation__step(event, step), loop_status_observation__run(event, run),
loop_status_observation__event_time(event, time), loop_status_observation__at(event, at),
status_observation_state(event, state), loop_status_observation__reason(event, reason).
status_latest(tenant, delivery, step, run, latest) :-
status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, _, _, _, _, _),
latest = max time : { status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, _, _, _, _) }.
status_contender(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason) :-
status_latest(tenant, delivery, step, run, time),
status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, _, _, state, reason).
// An undated reading can still disagree with the latest comparable reading.
status_contender(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason) :-
status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, -1, _, _, state, reason).
status_disagreement(tenant, delivery, step, run, reason) :-
status_contender(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason),
status_contender(tenant, delivery, step, run, other, _), state != other.
status_conflict(tenant, delivery, step, run) :- status_disagreement(tenant, delivery, step, run, _).
current_delivery_status(tenant, delivery, step, run, state, reason) :-
status_latest(tenant, delivery, step, run, time),
status_reading(tenant, delivery, step, run, time, _, _, state, reason),
!status_conflict(tenant, delivery, step, run).
current_delivery_status(tenant, delivery, step, run, "pending", reason) :-
status_disagreement(tenant, delivery, step, run, reason).
